unit.why: A short anecdote: the Belz rebbe's habit of healing a paralysed sick man by touching his whole body, a practice he said he received from the Maggid of Kozhnitz. It is habitual rather than a single event, so the story status is borderline.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם במכתב הנ"ל אמר הרה״ק מבעלזא
stories.summary_en: The Belz rebbe would heal a sick man who lay as if dead and could not move a limb by touching his whole body with his hands, and he said he had received this practice from the Maggid of Kozhnitz.

quotes: היה ממשש את כל גופו בידיו הקדושים
מישוש בידים לאיש החולה בכל גופו ויתרפא מיד
